hypothesis: The observed self-attention counts suggest a linear length cost plus a remainder penalty at nonmultiples of 16. Separate query and context slopes should also improve cross-attention predictions.

pcvs.name: query_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures query projection, output projection, and attention work that grows with query length.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * (hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1])
pcvs.name: context_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Allows context projection and normalization costs to have a separate fitted slope.

pcvs.name: uses_rotary
pcvs.rationale: Captures the substantial fixed overhead separating self-attention with rotary embeddings from cross-attention.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * (hidden_states.shape[1] % 16) if rotary_emb is not None else 0
pcvs.name: rotary_tail
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether vectorized kernel remainder handling explains elevated self-attention costs at lengths 9, 18, and 27 relative to multiples of 16.
